title: AgentCoMa: A Compositional Benchmark Mixing Commonsense and Mathematical Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (AgentCoMa) to evaluate the compositional reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models in practical scenarios like housework, shopping, and travel planning. It does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems, and its inclusion of a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section is excluded by the prompt instructions.
